segments.text:
V. 30.
He muſt increaſe, but I muſt decreaſe—So they who are now, like John, burning and ſhining lights, muſt (if not ſuddenly eclipſed) like him gradually decreaſe, while others are increaſing about them; as they, in their Turns, grew up, amidſt the Decays of the former Generation. Let us know how to ſet, as well as how to riſe; and let it comfort our declining Days, to trace in thoſe who are likely to ſucceed us in our Work, the Openings of yet greater Uſefulneſs.
